quiz.q: Which is a sign that stress needs attention?
options: Not sleeping or eating properly for many days
Feeling a little nervous before a mock
quiz.why: The answer is "Not sleeping or eating properly for many days". Reason: Persistent changes need support. The other choices, such as "Feeling a little nervous before a mock" and "Wanting a short break", do not fit the question.

quiz.q: Tele-MANAS number
quiz.why: The answer is "14416". Reason: National tele-mental health helpline. The other choices, such as "1915" and "1098", do not fit the question. (Question: Tele-MANAS number)

quiz.q: If a friend talks about harming themselves, you should
options: stay with them and help them reach a trusted adult or helpline
quiz.why: The answer is "stay with them and help them reach a trusted adult or helpline". Reason: Safety first; connect them with help. The other choices, such as "keep it secret" and "joke about it", do not fit the question.

quiz.q: Longer out-breaths tend to
quiz.why: The answer is "calm the body's stress response". Reason: They engage the parasympathetic system. The other choices, such as "cause dizziness always" and "increase panic", do not fit the question.

questions.q: The most efficient way to revise NCERT facts
questions.why: The answer is "active recall plus spaced review". Reason: Retrieval and spacing. The other choices, such as "highlighting everything" and "copying the book", do not fit the question.

questions.q: Where should you verify the current exam pattern?
questions.why: The answer is "Official information bulletin". Reason: Patterns can change. The other choices, such as "Old posters" and "Social media", do not fit the question.

questions.q: To avoid answer-sheet errors you should
options: mark all answers in the last minute
check the question number each time
questions.why: The answer is "check the question number each time". Reason: Prevents shifted answers. The other choices, such as "mark all answers in the last minute" and "not read instructions", do not fit the question.

questions.q: An error log is used to
questions.why: The answer is "target repeated mistakes". Reason: Fix causes. The other choices, such as "list books" and "record ranks", do not fit the question. (Question: An error log is used to)

questions.q: Interleaved practice
questions.why: The answer is "mixes topics". Reason: Builds flexible recall. The other choices, such as "is the same as cramming" and "avoids revision", do not fit the question.

questions.q: With +4/−1, 4 options and one option eliminated, guessing EV is
questions.why: The answer is "+2/3". Reason: ⅓ × 4 − ⅔ × 1. The other choices, such as "−1" and "+1.5", do not fit the question. (Question: With +4/−1, 4 options and one option eliminated, guessing EV is)

questions.q: A student skips sleep to study 16 hours daily and scores drop. Most likely reason
options: poor sleep impairs memory and attention
questions.why: The answer is "poor sleep impairs memory and attention". Reason: Sleep supports memory consolidation. The other choices, such as "bad luck" and "too little content", do not fit the question.

questions.q: If marking were +4/−2 with 4 options (hypothetical), the EV of a pure random guess
questions.why: The answer is "−0.5". Reason: ¼ × 4 − ¾ × 2 = 1 − 1.5. The other choices, such as "+0.25" and "0", do not fit the question. (Question: If marking were +4/−2 with 4 options (hypothetical), the EV of a pure random guess)

questions.q: A friend says, 'If I fail, there's no point living.' The best response
options: Take it seriously, stay with them, and help them contact a trusted adult, Tele-MANAS (14416) or 112
questions.why: The answer is "Take it seriously, stay with them, and help them contact a trusted adult, Tele-MANAS (14416) or 112". Reason: Treat as a safety concern; connect to help. The other choices, such as "Post about it online" and "Change the subject", do not fit the question.

questions.q: Which combination best reflects evidence-based preparation?
options: Active recall, spacing, timed mocks with error analysis, adequate sleep
questions.why: The answer is "Active recall, spacing, timed mocks with error analysis, adequate sleep". Reason: Each element is supported by learning research. The other choices, such as "Only watching lectures" and "Memorising toppers' timetables", do not fit the question.
